pages.title: Your workplace
pages.imageAlt: Employees working together in a bright, open-plan office

segments.text: Imagine that you are an employee at
NextGen, a large, fast-paced, tech-forward company
. Your role involves researching industry developments and contributing to important internal reports and presentations.
You are part of a
six-person team
whose members work together in a
hybrid environment
, both in-person and remotely. The team collaborates with tools such as Slack, Teams, email, and video calls.
One of your
peer teammates is Sam
, who holds a similar role and has been part of the team
for about as long as you have
. You and Sam have worked together regularly and have a
professional working relationship

pages.title: Two versions of Assist
pages.imageAlt: Comparison of OpenAssist using general information and CorpAssist using NextGen-specific information

segments.text: NextGen provides employees with access to an
AI chatbot called Assist
. Both versions of Assist are approved by NextGen and comply with the company's privacy and security requirements:

items.text: version comparable to leading AI chatbots (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini). It uses general information.
: A company-specific version with the same general capabilities as OpenAssist. It can also
, such as past reports, presentations, and company documents.

segments.text: The diagram below shows how the same question can produce different answers depending on which version you use.

pages.title: Where you use Assist
pages.imageAlt: Comparison of Assist in a shared team channel versus a private individual chat

segments.text: Either version of Assist can be used
individually on your own computer
(not visible to your teammates) or
in the team's shared workspace
In the shared workspace, teammates such as Sam can view your interactions with Assist and participate in the conversation. In an individual workspace, AI conversations are only visible to you.
The diagram below compares these two ways of using Assist.
The following scenarios concern an upcoming presentation that your team is preparing for NextGen's senior leadership team.
In each scenario, you will read about how you use Assist on a task while Sam works on another section of the same presentation. After each scenario, you will answer the same set of questions.
